summary: A sign-in form with a Turnstile captcha: no token without the check, reset() after a submit.
use: Public forms (sign-in, sign-up, waitlist, reset) that need a captcha token to verify on the server.
spec: `<Turnstile siteKey={SITE_KEY} action="sign-in" bind:handle />` between the Email field and the Sign in button
Submit reads `handle?.getToken()`, blocks with a message when it is empty, and calls `handle?.reset()` after sending
